EIA completed modeling and analysis for this report on Thursday, October 1, 2026.
The approximate break between historical and forecast values is shown with historical data with no shading; estimates and forecasts are shaded gray.
Capacity values represent the amount of generating capacity that is operating (or expected to be operating) at the end of each period.

Changes in capacity reflect various factors including new generators coming online, retiring generators, capacity uprates and derates, delayed planned capacity projects, cancelled projects, and other factors.
Historical data: Utility-scale capacity (power plants larger than one megawatt): EIA-860M Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory, July 2026.
Small-scale solar capacity (systems smaller than one megawatt): Form EIA-861M Monthly Electric Power Industry Report.
Historical capacity data may differ from other EIA publications due to frequent updates to the Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory.
Forecasts: Estimates of future capacity may include adjustments to reflect recent changes in market information or regulatory policy.
